faq.title: ❓ Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about Esa Bumindo adhesive products

items.question: What adhesive is suitable for metal applications?
items.answer: For metal applications, we recommend Esa Bumindo Epoxy Adhesive Series which has high bonding strength and durability. This product has been tested to bond various types of metals with optimal strength.

items.question: How long does Esa Bumindo adhesive take to dry?
items.answer: Drying time depends on the product type. For standard series: 24 hours for complete drying. For fast series: 4-6 hours. For optimal conditions, it is recommended to wait 24 hours before applying load to the bonded joint.

items.question: Is Esa Bumindo adhesive safe for skin?
items.answer: Our products are certified and safe to use. However, it is recommended to avoid direct skin contact. If contact occurs, wash with clean water immediately. Wear gloves during application for maximum safety.

items.question: What is the minimum price for bulk purchases?
items.answer: For bulk purchases (>100 units), we offer special prices that can be customized. Contact our sales team for the best offers and flexible payment terms.

items.question: What is the quality guarantee for Esa Bumindo products?
items.answer: All Esa Bumindo products come with an official 2-year warranty from the date of purchase. We guarantee quality and performance in accordance with the stated specifications. If there are manufacturing defects, they can be exchanged for free.

items.question: Can adhesive be applied on wet surfaces?
items.answer: It is not recommended to apply adhesive on very wet surfaces. Surfaces should be clean and dry for optimal results. If necessary, use our Water-resistant series which is specially designed for humid conditions.
